description: Price calculation formulas for artisan goods. Format: (input_price × multiplier) + addition

Dried Fruit.notes: Price = ((5 Fruits × Price) × 7.5) + 25g total / 5 = effective 1.5x per fruit

Dried Mushrooms.notes: Price = ((5 Mushrooms × Price) × 7.5) + 25g total / 5 = effective 1.5x per mushroom

Honey.notes: Price = (Flower Price × 2) + 100g. Wild Honey (no flower) = 100g base.

Targeted Bait.notes: Flat price of 5g regardless of input fish. Made in Bait Maker.
